title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine with Mexican Twist
description: A fusion of Saudi Arabian and Mexican flavors, this dish features tender chicken cooked in a warm and spicy tagine sauce. It's a unique and flavorful meal perfect for adventurous eaters.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, chipotle peppers, and tagine spice mix. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add browned chicken back to the pot, along with lime juice and cilantro. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
